subject: Enterprise Bill-To: invoice evidence bundle & PO locking
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quantumpay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement AP <ap@quantumpay.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor registration + PO 77881 — invoice evidence and acceptance criteria

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks for the quick follow-up on the enterprise bill-to onboarding. We're kicking off the vendor registration for Redwood as a supplier for our EU entity and need a small evidence bundle to satisfy our AP gate before we can accept PO 77881.

What we need from you:
- PDF sample invoice (with Redwood Bill-To name and the PO number visible)
- Proof of bank account (bank statement stub or voided check) matching remit details
- VAT registration / EORI or self-cert for reverse-charge (EU)
- Clarification on your PO acceptance: does Redwood require portal-level "PO acceptance" (we call it PO locking) or is referencing the PO on the invoice sufficient?

I've attached the PO PDF for reference. Our vendor portal link is below — please register and upload documents there if possible (portal accepts PDF/PNG). If you prefer, attach to an email reply and we'll ingest.

Alex Mercer
Sourcing Manager, QuantumPay Ltd
alex.mercer@quantumpay.com
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachment: PO_77881.pdf
Link: https://portal.quantumpay.com/vendor/register?ref=QP-77881

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quantumpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-17T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO 77881 — invoice evidence and acceptance criteria

Alex — thanks, received. We're happy to move quickly on this. A couple quick clarifications so we provide exactly what's required:

1) PO locking vs PO reference: we can do either. Our standard approach is to reference the PO number on the invoice and accept via an internal AP workflow; if your portal requires an explicit "accept" action (PO locking) we'll mark the PO accepted in your portal as part of registration. Which would you prefer?

2) Bill-to / remit: confirm that the Bill-To should be "Redwood Inference, Inc. (EU Branch) - Bill-To ID: 77881" or if you require a specific legal entity name and address to appear.

3) VAT evidence: we'll attach the EU VAT self-cert and our EORI (if required). For some customers we submit a short supplier declaration + VAT registration image — does that meet your AP policy?

Plan / timeline:
- Ben to register Redwood in your portal and upload invoice sample + bank stub (today)
- Laura to assemble the AP evidence packet and sign the supplier attestation (today)
- I will confirm PO acceptance preference and complete any portal confirmation (by EOD)

If helpful I've included the portal link you pasted and a DocuSign route if you need an executed supplier attestation.

Best,
So (Sojin Lee)
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quantumpay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement AP <ap@quantumpay.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO 77881 — invoice evidence and acceptance criteria

Thanks Sojin — portal-level PO locking is preferred for our larger bill-to relationships (gives our AP team a consistent enrolled status). If you can:

- Register Redwood in the portal and click "Accept PO 77881" after the vendor profile is created (it creates a PO lock flag on our side).
- Invoice must show: PO number, your billing legal entity, VAT ID (or self-cert note), and Bank Identifier (IBAN/BIC for EU).
- Bill-To ID should be exactly: QuantumPay EU / Bill-To 77881 / Finance GL: QP-EU-2000 (internal only — not required on invoice but helpful in the portal metadata).

Portal note: we received your company name as "Redwood Inference" — please ensure the legal entity line shows the EU branch if possible (we do checks against your VAT).

I've uploaded a portal screenshot and re-attached the PO. If you want the DocuSign route for the attestation, use this envelope: https://docusign.net/ envelope/1234abc-PO-77881

Alex
Attachment: portal-screenshot.png; PO_77881.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO 77881 — next steps and internal owners

Looping in internal owners and summarizing next steps.

Summary: QuantumPay requires portal-level PO locking for enterprise bill-to. They also want VAT evidence and bank stub. Action items:

- Ben Carter: create vendor profile in QuantumPay portal, upload the following by today EOD: PDF invoice sample (include PO 77881), bank statement stub, VAT self-cert / EORI. Confirm legal entity line includes "EU Branch". (owner: ben_carter)
- Soojin: confirm whether we will use the DocuSign attestation or portal-only upload. If DocuSign, I'll send the redwood_ap_packet for signature. (owner: soojin_lee)
- I'll prepare a compact AP packet for QuantumPay (redwood-ap-packet_v1.pdf) that includes: supplier attestation language, VAT self-cert, and accounting contact.

Risk notes: if the portal rejects based on legal entity mismatch we may need an expedited exception to have the PO accepted manually by QuantumPay AP — will flag immediately.

I'll attach the packet and a suggested invoice template. Ben — ping me in Slack if you run into a field mismatch.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-ap-packet_v1.pdf
